title: Backend, CLI workspace or HCP Terraform workspace?

questions.ask: Must environments have separate access, so dev credentials cannot apply to prod?
questions.yes: Separate root modules, or separate HCP Terraform workspaces

questions.ask: Variables, credentials and run history per environment, with team permissions?
questions.yes: HCP Terraform workspaces, grouped in projects

questions.ask: Did two engineers overwrite each other's changes?
Must state be restored after a bad state push?
questions.yes: Bucket versioning or HCP Terraform state versions

otherwise: A throwaway copy to test a change in the same directory: a CLI workspace
caption: Read the question's clue against each row from the top: the first yes is the answer the exam wants.
alt: Decision ladder: separate access points to separate root modules or HCP Terraform workspaces; per-environment variables to HCP Terraform workspaces; overwrites to locking; restore to versioning; otherwise a CLI workspace.
